title: Parker by Perfectly: Your AI career super-connector
tagline: Meet Parker, connect with people that unlocks your dream opportunities.
detail_body:
Hi, all,

We’re [Victor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-luo/), [Gary](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zhuang-luo/) and [Huimin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/huimin-xie/) - we’re building [Perfectly](https://www.perfectly.so/) 👋

# **TL;DR**

**Parker is your AI career super-connector that pulls strings to actually get you in front of your dream company.**

**Try Parker for free now**: <https://candidate.perfectly.so/>

70-80% of tech jobs are filled through referrals before they ever hit a job board. If you aren't talking to the right people, the best opportunities will never find you.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8kbBnTUYr0>

# **The problem**

You can be a top-tier candidate, but **if you aren't in the right room, your value goes unnoticed.**

The vast majority of jobs are filled via backchannels and warm intros. Relying on job boards means you're already too late.

# **What Parker does**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98761&key=user_uploads/2976280/9cbb9631-fb13-45df-8881-0fa5b7778efb)

**Parker is your AI career super-connector** **on iMessage and WhatsApp** that actually gets you, knows everyone in tech, and connects you to the roles you deserve.

1. **It knows the right people—and connects you with them:** Parker understands the market and maps out exactly who you should connect with. Then, Parker drafts highly personalized outreach messages that actually sound like you, getting you in the door.
2. **It gets you in front of hiring managers:** Companies come to us to hire directly—meaning the opportunities start coming to you. No more applying into the void.

# **How it works**

1. **Share your background:** Drop your LinkedIn, resume and basic info. Parker does its homework.
2. **Chat naturally:** Text Parker on iMessage/WhatsApp. It learns what you want through conversation, not rigid forms.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98761&key=user_uploads/2976280/b2ecac80-317c-4f69-af9d-64e7296d1fa6)

3. **Make the connection:** Get real intel, warm connections, and outreach drafts for the companies you care about.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98761&key=user_uploads/2976280/ee4025c0-12e3-48a9-93f2-9f7428e1c742)

4. **Get discovered:** Join Perfectly's network and let the teams that need your exact skills apply to _you_.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98761&key=user_uploads/2976280/1fa25d62-86c3-4692-9f39-5996d556b92d)

# **Why we built this**

We originally started on the hiring manager side (Meet Paul: <https://hm.perfectly.so/>) to help companies hire. But we kept seeing the same heartbreaking pattern: brilliant candidates stuck in the wrong roles simply because no one helped them find the place they truly belong.

So we built **Parker**. Because **your value shouldn't be a secret**.

**Try Parker for free now**: <https://candidate.perfectly.so/>

Text Parker. Don't be surprised when it knows things about yourself that you don't.
